Senses.Explanation: Literally, to examine and awaken; in the Chan records, to come to understand. The term occurs 229 times in 98 allowlisted texts, chiefly as a biographical result clause. A monk is told to wash his bowl and suddenly understands; Shigong cannot bring himself to shoot Mazu and understands; a layman is asked whether he understands and suddenly does; and Daowu hears a spirit-medium's song and suddenly understands. An instructional record also says there must be a basis for understanding and warns against stopping after grasping a few fixed phrases. The term records the narrator's or teacher's verdict that understanding occurred; the word itself adds no account of what was understood.
Senses.Note: One verbal event across sudden and unmodified forms. The various occasions—speech, question, action, or heard song—are causes supplied by their narratives, not separate senses of the word.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師曰。洗鉢盂去。其僧忽然省悟。上堂。纔有是非。紛然失心。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 五燈會元. An unnamed monk is the exact person who suddenly awakens after Zhaozhou Congshen tells him to wash his bowl. The line, expanded context, section header, book title, TEI header, and parallel-passage review do not supply a personal name.

Occurrences.Kwic: 石鞏慧藏禪師初為獵人射鹿，因遇馬，祖令自射，無下手處，省悟。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 禪宗正脉. Record of Lineage Pivot Essentials (宗門統要續集), Shigong Huizang biography. Shigong Huizang is the exact grammatical actor: while still a deer-hunter he meets Mazu Daoyi, cannot shoot when Mazu orders him to shoot himself, and awakens.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師曰。還會麼。居士忽然省悟。有頌云。心鏡從來瑩。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Continued Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), Yunfeng Yuanyi entry. The personally named layman Li Linzong is the exact actor who suddenly awakens after Yunfeng Yuanyi asks whether he understands and then gives a verse; Xuedou Chongxian is only the lineage-header teacher.

Occurrences.Kwic: 聞巫者樂神云：識神無。忽然省悟。後參前關南，印其所解。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Complete Book of the Five Lamps, volumes 1–33 (五燈全書(第1卷-第33卷)), Guannan Daowu biography. Guannan Daowu is the exact grammatical actor who hears a spirit-medium's song saying 'Do you know the spirit?' and suddenly awakens; he later visits the former Guannan master, who certifies his understanding.

Occurrences.Kwic: 須知有省悟之由若真實叅學但恁麼看據現定會些子言句便休也在
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 古尊宿語錄, Foyan Qingyuan's general address after recounting Chaling Yu's awakening. Foyan Qingyuan is the exact speaker: he tells listeners they must know that awakening has an occasion and warns genuine students against stopping at a few presently understood phrases.
